requirements.quote:
QUIC endpoints measure the delay incurred between when a packet is
   received and when the corresponding acknowledgment is sent, allowing
   a peer to maintain a more accurate RTT estimate; see Section 13.2 of
   [QUIC-TRANSPORT].
requirements.condition: When a QUIC endpoint sends an acknowledgment corresponding to a received packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint measures the delay between receiving the packet and sending the corresponding acknowledgment so that the peer can maintain a more accurate RTT estimate.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint does not send the corresponding acknowledgment without measuring the delay between packet receipt and acknowledgment transmission.
requirements.error_behavior: No error behavior is specified in this chunk.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can record packet-receipt and acknowledgment-send times and verify that the endpoint computes the elapsed delay for the corresponding acknowledgment.
